Name: Ranch Helper Mod
Author: NecroZide
Description:
[b]🌟 Features
[/b]
✅ [b]Auto-Pet All Animals[/b] – No more forgotten pets!
✅ [b]Collects Products Instantly[/b] – Eggs, milk, wool, truffles, feathers, and more.
✅ [b]Machine Harvesting[/b] – Collects from mayo machines, cheese presses, etc.
✅ [b]Inventory Alerts[/b] – Warns if your inventory is full.
✅ [b]Detailed Reports[/b] – Shows how many animals were petted and items collected.
✅ [b]XP Gain[/b] – Grants farming XP for collections.
[line][b]How It Works:
[/b]
Press the [b]O key[/b] (default) to:
[list=1]
[*]Pet all unpetted animals in coops/barns.

[*]Collect products:
[list]
[*]Directly from animals (e.g., milk, wool).
[*]From the ground (e.g., eggs, truffles).
[*]From machines (e.g., mayo, cheese)
[/list][*]Display a summary (e.g., [i]"Petted 12 animals. Collected 5 Eggs, 3 Milk, 2 Truffles."[/i]).

[/list][b]Compatibility:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with [b]all vanilla animals[/b] (cows, chickens, pigs, etc.).
[*]Supports [b]modded animals[/b] if they use standard Category -5 for products.
[*]No known conflicts with other mods.
[/list]
[line][b]⚠️ Requirements

[/b][list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b](3.0 or later)
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]
[/list][line][b]📦 Installation

[/b][list=1]
[*]Download the mod and unzip it.

[*]Place the RanchHelperMod folder in your Mods directory.

[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.

[/list][line][b]❓ FAQ
[/b]
[b]Q:[/b] Can I change the hotkey?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! Config file is added with the zip file!
[b]Q:[/b] Does it work with Automate or Autograbbers?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! It complements them (collects from autograbbers too).
[b]Q:[/b] Will it pet my horse/cat/dog?
[b]A:[/b] No—only barn/coop animals.
